conventions.flops: 2 x multiply-accumulates of matrix products only (linear layers, QK^T, AV, SSM state contractions, convolutions); norms, activations, softmax, RoPE, routing top-k not counted (torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode)
conventions.attention_causal: a query at position i attends min(i, W) keys; prefill amortised = sum_i min(i, W) / L
conventions.attention_dense: every query of an L-token prefill scores all L keys (HF eager / SDPA; what FlopCounterMode measures); decode identical to causal
conventions.decode_at_L: the cache holds L - 1 tokens and the step produces token L; a window layer attends min(L, W) keys
conventions.lm_head: prefill counts the LM head at every position, decode once
conventions.kv_window: a sliding-window layer caches its W - 1 most recent tokens (transformers DynamicSlidingWindowLayer): min(L, W - 1) tokens after L
conventions.mla: headline KV = the latent (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim per layer, as vLLM / SGLang / FlashMLA cache it); kv_materialized = per-head K and V (transformers DynamicCache); FLOPs follow the transformers code (kv_b_proj expanded per token, attention on per-head K / V)
conventions.k_eq_v: a K = V layer (no v_proj) caches K and V as two tensors, as transformers (Gemma-4: V = v_norm(k_proj x), K = RoPE(k_norm(k_proj x)), both passed to cache.update), vLLM and llama.cpp allocate them; DeepSeek-V4's cache aliases V to K and holds one; kv_minimum counts one tensor for every K = V layer
conventions.weights: params x dtype bytes; quantisation scales and zero points ignored
conventions.memory: weights (bf16) + KV(L) (bf16) + recurrent state (bf16), batch 1 and batch B (weights once)
conventions.bandwidth: one decode step: active non-embedding weights + LM head + one embedding row, the KV read over the attended span of every layer, the recurrent state read and written (bf16 throughout)
